hints.title: Modulo 24 Partition
hints.text: Any two durations hours[i] and hours[j] form a complete day if (hours[i] + hours[j]) % 24 == 0.

hints.title: Complement Pairing
hints.text: For each hour, compute remainder r = h % 24 and required complement (24 - r) % 24.

hints.title: 64-bit Accumulation
hints.text: Use a 64-bit integer to accumulate matches from a frequency array of size 24.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countCompleteDayPairs(self, hours: list[int]) -> int:
        cnt = [0] * 24
        ans = 0
        for h in hours:
            rem = h % 24
            comp = (24 - rem) % 24
            ans += cnt[comp]
            cnt[rem] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested loop exceeds time limit for n = 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize modulo 24 complement pairs and linear frequency accumulation.
